text: Set temperature to 0.0 for factual question answering. Higher temperature increases hallucination in grounded RAG tasks.
chunk_size determines retrieval precision and is locked at index time. A bad chunking decision is a permanent tax until you re-index.
similarity_threshold above 0.72 prevents confident answers on off-topic queries. Without it the LLM uses irrelevant context.
A reranker is a cross-encoder that scores query-chunk pairs. The two-stage pattern retrieves top_k then reranks to top_n for better precision.
top_k controls how many chunks you retrieve. top_k=20 triples latency and cost for marginal quality gain compared to top_k=8.
In MCP agents, set temperature 0.0 for tool calling to avoid tool name hallucination. Always define max_steps and an execution budget.
Destructive tools must be gated behind human confirmation. require human approval before close or delete operations.
memory_window_turns controls how many conversation turns are sent each call. Larger windows cost more; summarize evicted turns.
